name: bot-by-ai
description: Modular Discord bot, security suite and web dashboard

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bot-by-ai/shared && npm run build -w @bot-by-ai/database && npm run build -w @bot-by-ai/bot && npm run build -w @bot-by-ai/dashboard
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @bot-by-ai/shared && npm run build -w @bot-by-ai/database
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck -w @bot-by-ai/shared && npm run typecheck -w @bot-by-ai/database && npm run typecheck -w @bot-by-ai/bot && npm run typecheck -w @bot-by-ai/dashboard && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck:all && npm run test && npm run build
